# Content Review

This skill delegates to the full content review guidelines maintained in `.claude/skills/content-review/`.

When reviewing a blog post, read and apply all of the following:

- `.claude/skills/content-review/front-matter.md` — required front matter fields and validation rules
- `.claude/skills/content-review/editorial-standards.md` — editorial standards and compliance checks
- `.claude/skills/content-review/formatting.md` — formatting rules for markdown, code blocks, images, and links
- `.claude/skills/content-review/seo.md` — SEO requirements
- `.claude/skills/content-review/voice-tone-tense.md` — brand voice, tone, and tense guidelines
- `.claude/skills/content-review/writing-principles.md` — writing principles and style rules

Report findings grouped by severity: **MUST FIX**, **SHOULD FIX**, and **SUGGESTION**.
